name: Charles Meynier

summary.text: Charles Meynier was a French painter of historical subjects in the late 18th and early 19th century. He was a contemporary of Antoine-Jean Gros and Jacques-Louis David.
summary.title: Charles Meynier

65097256: Entry of Napoleon into Berlin is an 1810 painting by the French artist Charles Meynier. It depicts the entry of the French Emperor Napoleon into the Prussian capital Berlin on 27 October 1806, following his victory at the Battle of Jena.
137196138: Napoleon's Return to the Island of Lobau After the Battle of Essling is an 1812 history painting by the French artist Charles Meynier. It depicts a scene from the War of the Fifth Coalition, part of the wider Napoleonic Wars.
